title: Entrust your villa to people who live here
lede: We look after a small number of private houses in Ibiza — marketing them properly, filling the calendar and taking care of the details that owners should not have to think about from another country.
image_alt: A villa terrace on the south-west coast of Ibiza

sections.title: A villa is not a listing
paragraphs: The best rentals are run like small hotels: the right photography, honest copy, a calendar that is actually up to date, and a team who can solve a broken air-conditioning unit on a Sunday in August.

We represent owners directly, with no layers in between. You deal with the people who look after your house, and we deal with everything else — the guests, the changeovers, the maintenance, the paperwork.
sections.image_alt: A turquoise pool above the sea
sections.caption: Cala Vadella, south west Ibiza.

items.title: Marketing & photography
items.text: A proper shoot, honest copy and placement across our site and partner channels.

items.title: Pricing & calendar
items.text: Seasonal pricing, minimum stays and availability kept in sync with your own bookings.

items.title: Guest care
items.text: Enquiries, contracts, deposits, check-in, welcome and a number guests can call at any hour.

items.title: Housekeeping & maintenance
items.text: Changeovers, linen, pool and garden, and a trusted list of trades who turn up when they say they will.

items.title: Licensing & compliance
items.text: Guidance on tourist rental licences, insurance and the paperwork the island now asks for.

items.title: Reporting
items.text: Clear monthly statements, occupancy and revenue — no surprises at the end of the season.

sections.title: From first visit to first booking

items.title: We visit
items.text: We come to the house, take our own photographs and talk through what you want from the season.

items.title: We plan
items.text: A pricing and calendar proposal, a photography and copy plan, and a clear agreement on what we handle.

items.title: We launch
items.text: The villa goes live on our site and partner channels, with the calendar connected and enquiries answered the same day.

items.title: We look after it
items.text: Guests, changeovers, maintenance and reporting — with one person accountable for your house.

sections.text: Most of our owners came to us through another owner. That is the only review that matters.

sections.title: Tell us about your villa
sections.text: Send a few details — location, bedrooms, whether you already rent it — and we will come and see it.
